import sys
import re

def document_analyser(doc):
    # Words outside parentheses: remove all parenthesized parts
    outside = re.sub(r'\([^)]*\)', '', doc)
    word = re.compile(r'\p{L}+')
    longest = 0
    for match in word.finditer(outside):
        length = len(match.group())
        if length > longest:
            longest = length

    # Words inside parentheses: extract each parenthesized part
    words_inside = 0
    paren = re.compile(r'\(([^)]*)\)')
    for match in paren.finditer(doc):
        inside = match.group(1)
        for m2 in word.finditer(inside):
            words_inside += 1

    return [longest, words_inside]

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())  # read and ignore the integer
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    res = document_analyser(s)
    print(f"{res[0]} {res[1]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
